'''Gorrel's Staff''' is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Gorrel Rockmolder]], a [[boss]] in [[Grenth's Footprint]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +10
:[[Chaos damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Illusion Magic]])
:Halves casting time of [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%)
:[[Health]] +30
: Health +30
:Reduces [[Deep Wound]] duration on you by 20% (Stacking)

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Jeweled Staff]]

== Replica ==
This staff cannot be replicated for several reasons:
* It effectively has two [[inscription]]s, "Serenity Now" and "Strength of Body."
* "Strength of Body" is only available as an [[off-hand]] inscription. 
* It lacks the inherent 20% [[HSR]] that is present on all fully modifiable staves, except [[Envoy Staff]].

== Notes ==
* Only three other staves have two inscriptions and are missing a HSR 20% mod: [[Brohn's Staff]], [[Heleyne's Insight]] and [[Villnar's Staff]].
